newsitem.title: USA: U.S. budget meeting to focus on domestic programs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. budget meeting to focus on domestic programs.

text.p: White House and congressional budget negotiators meeting Wednesday will discuss domestic spending, the approximately one-sixth of the budget approved each year for programs ranging from national parks to education, House Budget Committee chairman John Kasich, Republican of Ohio, said.

The meeting is to open at 2 p.m. EDT (1600 GMT). Negotiators include Office of Management and Budget director Frank Raines, congressional liaison John Hilley, Economic Policy Council chairman Gene Sperling, and House and Senate Budget Committees' Republican chairmen and ranking Democrats.
